who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), host round 2 lane 'made facts', port-memo-1113
where: crates/blaze-items/src/facts.rs const_value, hidden_types; crates/blaze-item-hash/src/values.rs escaped; crates/hir-ty-pure/src/own.rs own_effects
what: The brief pointed at blaze-item-hash/src/values.rs for the form of the made values ConstValue and HiddenTypes, but they live in blaze-items/src/facts.rs, and the four kinds a body makes (ConstValue, HiddenType, Escaped, Effects) are now in three crates.
cost: a search across crates to find the form to follow
cause: a made fact's value is written next to whatever analysis computes it, with no one module listing the kinds a body makes and where each value comes from
class: one concept (a body's made facts) with no home, so a reader cannot find all its members from one place
prevention: one table in blaze-front/src/facts.rs (or blaze-keyed's FactKind doc) naming, per made kind, the function that gives its value
workaround: rg for FactKind::Escaped and the made kinds
